facts.fact: Stamp Me's pricing page states that no credit card is required to see how the service works.
Stamp Me's pricing page states that its plans have no lock-in contract.
Stamp Me's pricing page states that customers can cancel at any time.
The Stamp Me 'Simply the Basics' plan is listed at $49 USD per month.
The Stamp Me 'Simply the Basics' plan is listed at AUD 49 per month, excluding GST.
The Stamp Me 'Simply the Basics' plan is listed at £39 per month and €29 per month in the UK and euro-zone price points.
The Stamp Me 'The Full Works' plan is listed at $79 USD per month.
The Stamp Me 'The Full Works' plan is listed at AUD 79 per month, excluding GST.
The Stamp Me 'The Full Works' plan is listed at £49 and €49 per month in the UK and euro-zone price points.

Stamp Me's pricing page describes its integrations as pushing member data to mailing or CRM platforms through a wide range of integrations available via Zapier.
facts.quote: Push member data through to your mailing or CRM platforms with a wide range of integrations available through Zapier.

facts.fact: Stamp Me's pricing page lists support tiers of webchat and email, and webchat, email and phone.

facts.quote: A simple, no-frills digital stamp card, nothing more.
